title: Prompt2Image joins Creative Projects
summary:
A community-made VS Code extension makes prompt-to-image generation easier to find.

The Creative Projects listing now includes @MaazS07’s Prompt2Image VS Code extension. Developers can use the Command Palette to turn a prompt into a project-ready image through Pollinations.ai.

daily.title: Images from VS Code
daily.text: Find Prompt2Image in Creative Projects, then generate project-ready images from a prompt in the VS Code Command Palette. [Explore community projects](https://pollinations.ai).
